title: Belton Wellington Memorial
memorial_details: Stained-glass window to Sgt D.R. Sharman, missing 11 October 1944, in All Saints Church, Belton, Norfolk.
narrative: Wellington NC721 of 19 Operational Training Unit departed Kinloss at 2004 on 11 October 1944. The aircraft failed to return. Sgt D.R. Sharman is commemorated in a stained-glass window at All Saints Church, Belton, Norfolk.

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 7
Tony Hibberd (RAF Bomber Command Memorials Facebook group, admin post)
